SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. BR. REGISTRY
No. N. 867 (C)
Date. 26 / 5 / 41

S.I. (Special Branch) Station. File No. Date May 24, 1941

SUBJECT: Alexander Crichton

Alexander Crichton, British, was born
in Scotland on February 4th, 1904. He served
10 years in the Royal Navy from 1921 to 1930
and left that service with a "very good"
character.

Whilst in the Royal Navy, he made a name
for himself as a Welter-Weight Boxer and upon
his discharge, he became a Boxing Instructor
in Shanghai. He fought many professional fights
locally and in 1931 applied to join the S.M.P.

Crichton was accepted and enlisted on
September 1st, 1931. Whilst still under
training at the Police Training Depot, he was
charged under S.M.P. Rules and Regulations
with Discreditable Conduct and Absence without
Leave after becoming involved in a fight with
civilians in a French Concession cabaret.

Educationally his progress was very poor
and he was deemed not likely to become an
efficient Police Officer. In view of the charges
against him, he was asked to resign from the
S.M.P. This he did on January 24th, 1932.

After leaving the S.M.P., Crichton was
employed in various small positions by British
firms both in Shanghai and the outports. He
was, however, usually successful in finding
some outlet for his pugilistic ability either
in the boxing ring or in private quarrels.

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别股登记室
编号 N. 867 (C)
日期 1941年5月26日

特别股警署。档案号。日期 1941年5月24日

主题：Alexander Crichton

Alexander Crichton，英国人，1904年2月4日出生于苏格兰。他于1921年至1930年在皇家海军服役10年，退役时品行评定为“甚佳”。

在皇家海军服役期间，他作为一名次中量级拳击手而闻名，退役后成为上海的一名拳击教练。他在本地参加过多场职业拳击比赛，并于1931年申请加入上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）。

Crichton 被录取并于1931年9月1日入职。在警察训练所受训期间，因卷入一起与平民在法租界歌舞厅的斗殴事件，他被依据《上海公共租界工部局警务处规章条例》指控犯有行为不检及擅离职守罪。

他的学业进展非常糟糕，被认为不太可能成为一名能干的警官。鉴于针对他的指控，他被要求从上海公共租界工部局警务处辞职。他于1932年1月24日照办。

离开上海公共租界工部局警务处后，Crichton 在上海及各外埠的英国公司担任过各种小职员职务。然而，他通常都能在拳击台或私人争吵中为其拳击能力找到施展的途径。

（批注：AC(特别股) 现可归档！）
